title: company-quarter-synthesis-ops-canvas-and-asks-v0-1
content:
Purpose: Draft synthesis for the upcoming company all-hands + exec update. This is a working canvas intended to align leadership asks, a compact set of company-level OKR candidates, and a minimal comms/slide pack for the all-hands.

Audience: Execs + cross-functional leads; primary owners for each ask should be clearly assigned before the draft goes to final.

High-level framing (one sentence): Q2 is about operationalizing predictability — make inference behavior (latency, cost, availability) reliable across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments while lowering unit cost for our top 5 customer workloads.

Company-level OKR candidates (draft):
- Objective A: Make inference predictable for production customers
  - KR A1: 95th percentile end-to-end latency <= 120ms for top 5 hosted models under 99% traffic mix (baseline: 190ms)
  - KR A2: Reduce per-token hosted cost by 18% for the top 3 enterprise request profiles (baseline: $0.0007/token)
  - KR A3: Run 3 cross-region failover drills with <5% request loss and <2x latency degradation

- Objective B: Enterprise readiness and scale for Dedicated & Private
  - KR B1: Close 2 privacy/regulatory integrations (KMS HSM + SOC audit gap closure) with initial customers signed for Private deploys
  - KR B2: Achieve 99.9% scheduled-capacity uptime for Dedicated pools across primary customers (measured monthly)

- Objective C: Developer velocity for customers & internal teams
  - KR C1: Ship per-route tracing hooks and rollout UI in Console with adoption by 6 teams
  - KR C2: Provide model/offline quantization recipes that reduce memory usage by at least 25% on target GPU families

Notes on scope and prioritization: These are deliberately small — two operational objectives + one developer-velocity bucket. If we try to bake product feature OKRs here (e.g., new Hosted endpoints), this doc becomes too broad for exec alignment.

All-hands draft agenda (45 mins exec + 30 mins company Q&A):
- 00:00 - 05:00: Welcome + CEO framing: Why predictability this quarter (3 bullets)
- 05:00 - 12:00: Product demo: Per-route tracing + rollout example (owner: Leah)
- 12:00 - 20:00: Engineering highlight: Dedicated capacity SLO improvements (owner: Noah)
- 20:00 - 28:00: Customer story: Onboarding Private beta (customer rep & AE)
- 28:00 - 35:00: Metrics snapshot: latency/cost trends and KR baselines (owner: Arjun)
- 35:00 - 43:00: Roadmap & asks: cross-functional asks and headline launches (owner: Maya)
- 43:00 - 60:00: Live Q&A + close

Exec update slide skeleton (3 slides):
- Slide 1: 6-panel snapshot (health signals): latency P95, hosted unit cost, Dedicated uptime, Private pipeline status, capacity headroom, top risk
- Slide 2: Key asks (1 slide): list of decisions we want this week (see Asks section)
- Slide 3: Next 60 days: timeline with owners and milestones

Asks (priority ordered):
1) Approve the proposed company OKR set (Objective A/B/C) so we can finalize team-level cascades by EOD Friday. Owner: Maya.
2) Greenlight an extra $250k in burst credits for Dedicated capacity testing (finance approval needed). Owner: Noah + Finance liaison.
3) Approve the customer-facing comms template for Private beta (legal/security sign-off). Owner: Priya.
4) Exec commit: participate in one failover drill during the quarter (scheduling ask). Owner: Arjun + Exec assistants.

Risks & Mitigations (top 5):
- Risk: Latency improvements require kernel work that may slip into Q3.
  - Mitigation: Identify 2 interim routing/policy tweaks to deliver partial gains; contingency KR for 2 incremental latency features.
- Risk: Dedicated capacity failures at scale if autoscaler rules are too aggressive.
  - Mitigation: Add canary nodes and circuit-breaker policies; execute a canary week with synthetic load.
- Risk: Private deployment onboarding resource constraints (support/SE bandwidth).
  - Mitigation: Freeze non-critical launches; pool solutions engineering hours into rapid-start kits.
- Risk: Finance pushback on additional burst credits.
  - Mitigation: Provide cost/benefit with experiments plan and rollback threshold.
- Risk: Messaging misalignment with sales/customer success on SLA promises.
  - Mitigation: Draft a joint messaging doc and circulate for 48-hour review.

Decision log (open):
- Do we set the latency KR at 120ms or 140ms? Open question — engineering to surface feasibility with data by Tue.
- Which 5 customer workloads should define the hosted KR? Suggested: image-gen-std, chat-support-1, summarization-large, embeddings-batch, reranker-prod. Confirm via product metrics.

Milestones & timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Finalize OKRs, assign owners, public communication to company; publish slide deck draft
- Week 2: Release per-route tracing preview to internal partners; Dedicated autoscaler canary
- Week 4: Run first cross-region failover drill; customer comms for Private beta updated
- Week 6: KR checkpoint and exec review

Comms plan (short):
- Internal: Short all-hands memo + 1-page OKR summary posted to Confluence and #company-updates on day of all-hands.
- External: Post-customer blog + handout for Private beta customers after we complete first failover drill.

Slide & collateral needs (owners):
- One-pager OKR summary: Maya (draft) + Leah (product copy)
- Metrics dashboard snapshot: Arjun (embedding chart + cost curves)
- Failover drill playbook: SRE (Noah) + Leah (ops runbook)

Open/fragile items / notes to self: 
- Need definitive baseline numbers for per-token cost (Arjun to provide raw query distribution by Tue).
- Investigate whether we can use quantized variants for Hosted fallback before kernel changes (ask: research to confirm 1 week).
- Ask marketing for 2 customer quotes for the Private beta slide by next Wed.
- Decide whether to include Dedicated headcount ask in public all-hands (sensitive HR topic) — probably keep to exec-only.

Appendix: Short draft messaging for all-hands (to be edited):
- CEO bullet: "This quarter we're moving from 'fast demos' to 'predictable inference' — because customer ROI requires consistent performance, not occasional magic."
- Engineering: "Major wins: we've cut p50 by 30% with new batching heuristics; next up is P95 and tail behavior."
- Customer: "Private beta is live with 2 customers in regulated industries; note: still onboarding infra and compliance checks."

Next steps:
- By Thurs EOD: Exec review doc and respond to the Asks list.
- By Friday: Publish final OKR set and trigger team-level planning sessions.

Unresolved: which exec will present the Dedicated uptime slide? (Maya to confirm)

"Notes to self": keep slide deck under 10 slides and avoid product launch minutiae; focus on health + asks + two customer outcomes.

---- END WORKING DRAFT ----

Version history: v0-1 initial canvas (Maya)
